Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited (TPREL) is one of India’s leading renewable energy companies, driving the transition towards a cleaner, more resilient and sustainable energy future. 

As a subsidiary of Tata Power Company Limited, TPREL delivers integrated green energy solutions across solar, wind, hybrid, round-the-clock (RTC), peak power, floating solar and energy storage technologies. With capabilities spanning project development, engineering, procurement, construction, operations and maintenance, the company plays a pivotal role across the renewable energy value chain.
Today, TPREL has a renewable utility portfolio of 11.6 GW, including 6.7 GW of operational capacity comprising solar and wind assets, and 4.9 GW under implementation. The company has also established the country's largest single-location integrated solar cell and module manufacturing facility in Tirunelveli, Tamil Nadu, with a capacity of 4.3 GW.
Beyond utility-scale renewable projects, TPREL's integrated offerings span rooftop solar, distributed energy solutions, EV charging infrastructure and advisory services, enabling businesses, institutions and communities to accelerate their sustainability journeys.

With a solar EPC portfolio exceeding 16.8 GWp and around 5.1 GWp of rooftop and distributed installations, TPREL continues to support India's growing clean energy ambitions through innovation, scale and execution excellence.

As India advances towards a cleaner energy future, TPREL remains committed to enabling energy access at scale through integrated green energy solutions. Guided by innovation, responsibility and sustainable growth, we are helping build a future powered by clean energy and shared progress.
